claim: A cron() rotation schedule must have * in the year field, because Secrets Manager does not support rotation schedules that are more than a year apart; with a rate() expression the maximum rotation period is 999 days. Rotation schedules use the UTC time zone.

evidence.quote: It must have **\*** in the year field, because Secrets Manager does not support rotation schedules that are more than a year apart.
evidence.title: Rotation schedules

evidence.quote: Secrets Manager rotation schedules use UTC time zone.
evidence.title: Rotation schedules

evidence.quote: You can rotate a secret as often as every four hours. The maximum rotation period is 999 days.
